history.overview: The Upper Terrace was the highest ceremonial elevation of the Causeway, now fractured by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Terrace Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn artisans built the upper terrace for noble ascension rites.

timeline.name: Altar Era
timeline.description: Altars were erected to honor Dragorn lineage and noble houses.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the terrace and fortified its ledges.

timeline.name: Discord Fracturing
timeline.description: Discord fissures erupted, splitting altars and corrupting the stone.
